changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE shop_orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS refund_requested boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_order_refund_requested ON shop_orders (refund_requested, created_at);

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_order_messages ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sender_user_id bigint, sender_type varchar(32) NOT NULL, content varchar(2000) NOT NULL, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_message_sender CHECK (sender_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'SHOP_MANAGER')), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_order_message_content CHECK (char_length(trim(content)) > 0) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_order_message_order_created ON shop_order_messages (order_id, created_at, id);
